title: The names we carry
note: Use at least three approved patient identifiers, following local policy. Here they are full name, date of birth and medical record number. A wristband and chart carry identifiers; they are not additional identifiers. Check allergies separately before medicines are given.

start.speaker: Sam Okafor
start.text: You must be the one who came through the light. I’m still waiting for my medicine. Rowan left a preparation chart on the trolley, but something about it feels wrong.

choices.label: Introduce yourself and ask for full name and date of birth
Use the bed number to choose the chart

bed.speaker: Sage Rowan · a quiet reminder
bed.text: A bed is a place, not a person. People move, and names can be similar. Let’s begin again by asking the patient to state their details.

choices.label: Return to Sam and ask their details

stated.speaker: Sam Okafor
stated.text: I’m Sam Okafor. My date of birth is 12 March 1987. Thank you for asking instead of assuming. There is another Sam across the corridor.

choices.label: Compare three identifiers on the wristband and preparation chart
The first name matches. Proceed with preparation

shortcut.speaker: Sage Rowan
shortcut.text: A matching first name is not enough. Stop before preparing or giving anything. Check the full name, date of birth and medical record number against the correct record.

choices.label: Inspect the wristband and chart together

compare.speaker: Your assessment
compare.text: Sam’s stated details match the wristband. The preparation chart belongs to someone else. What will you do?

choices.label: Stop and ask Rowan to resolve the mismatch
Change the name on the chart to match the wristband

alter.speaker: Sage Rowan
alter.text: Don’t relabel another person’s record. Keep the mismatched preparation from being used and ask for help to locate and verify the correct record.

choices.label: Ask Rowan to resolve the mismatch

resolved.speaker: Sage Rowan
resolved.text: Well spotted. I’ve removed the other patient’s preparation chart and brought Sam’s correct record. Check it yourself before continuing.

choices.label: Confirm all three identifiers match, then check allergies
Rowan checked it, so skip my own check

recheck.speaker: Sage Rowan
recheck.text: Help from a colleague supports your check; it doesn’t replace it. Compare Sam’s full name, date of birth and medical record number yourself.

choices.label: Verify all three, then check allergies

allergy.speaker: Sam Okafor
allergy.text: I’ve had a reaction to penicillin before. It should be on my record. You check Sam’s account against the recorded allergy alert and flag it to Rowan. No medicine is administered in this tutorial.

choices.label: Record the resolved mismatch and hand back to Rowan

complete.speaker: Sam Okafor
complete.text: Back home, I repair the lanterns along the eastern bridge. Everyone remembers the lights. You remembered the person. Thank you.
